_comment: Who may use what on the admin and approval pages and who is offered the Admin link, so the browser shows and asks only for what it would be given (WORKORDER-approvalLooseEnds-112126 L4, L6, L7; given this name by WORKORDER-raterAndAdminLooseEnds-112226 R5, since it governs all of /admin). Read by components/accountAccessRules.js. The browser only decides whether to SHOW and ASK; every endpoint still decides from the role itself and refuses anyone else. Held equal to the server by server/test/account-approval-browser-rules.test.js.
_approverRoleList: a copy of server/lib/user-profile-rules.json approverRoleList: who may see and decide account applications.
_adminRoleList: the roles every admin-only endpoint behind the /admin tools allows (getValidator(['admin', 'super']) in admin-*, manifest-*, oauth-admin-* endpoints; raterStore's isRaterAdminRole and isAdmin read it for the Mapping Survey).
_roleListNameByToolName: per /admin tool (pages/admin.vue TOOL_NAME_LIST, every one listed): the role list above whose roles may use it, or anySignedIn for a tool that makes no admin-only request. A tool the signed-in user may not use is not shown, not mounted, and asks for nothing. The sidebar offers the Admin link only to a user who may use a tool that is not anySignedIn (R4).
